User.title: User Profile
User.description: User profile with game stats and authentication details.

displayName.description: The user's display name from Google.

createdAt.description: Date and time when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Date and time when the profile was last updated.

Tournament.title: Esports Tournament
Tournament.description: Esports match stats, participants, kills, and state.

title.description: The match title such as 'br solo'.

entryFee.description: Token fee to enter the tournament (e.g., 50).

time.description: The scheduled time of the match.

joinedPlayers.description: List of joined user statistics and details (custom map list).

status.description: Status of the match (Open or Ended).

announcements.description: List of announcements made by host, co-host, owner admin, or super admin.

AdminLog.title: Admin Action Log
AdminLog.description: Log of administrative actions taken by system coordinators.

adminRole.description: The administrative role of the admin.

actionType.description: High level action type (e.g. UPDATE_MATCH, DELETE_MATCH, DISTRIBUTE_PRIZES, ADD_ADMIN, REVOKE_ADMIN).

details.description: Detailed readable description of the action.

GlobalSettings.title: Global System Settings
GlobalSettings.description: Dynamic configurations such as customizable purchase rates for health, stars, and level-ups.

health.description: Cost in tokens for 1% health upgrade.

star.description: Cost in tokens for 1 star purchase.

level.description: Cost in tokens for 1 level up.

Team.title: Esports Team/Squad
Team.description: Full team/squad profile with name, cover banner, leader, and up to 6 members.

memberEmails.description: List of emails of all squad members for easy indexing.

members.description: List of members details (name, email, uid, role, status, etc.).

updatedAt.description: When the team was last updated.

TeamInvitation.title: Team Invitation
TeamInvitation.description: Team invite request sent to a friend's Gmail address.

senderId.description: UID of the team captain sending the invite.

recipientEmail.description: Email of the friend being invited.

DeviceStats.title: Device Stats
DeviceStats.description: Daily ad views tracked for a specific device.

count.description: Number of ads watched on this device today.

watchedIds.description: List of campaign IDs watched on this device today.

UpazilaSponsorAd.title: Upazila League Sponsor Ad
UpazilaSponsorAd.description: Banner and sponsor details for upazila league sponsor slots.

logoUrl.description: Image/logo URL for the sponsor banner.

TournamentSponsorAd.title: Tournament Sponsor Ad
TournamentSponsorAd.description: Ad slots displayed on the home screen/tournament hub header.

TournamentAdsHistory.title: Tournament Ads Financial History
TournamentAdsHistory.description: Records of token transactions related to tournament sponsor ads.

HostWallet.title: Host Locked Security Wallet
HostWallet.description: Security wallet holding locked league tokens for competitive matches.

hostId.description: The UID of the esports host.

balance.description: Tokens currently deposited and locked/unlocked in this wallet.

isLocked.description: Whether the wallet is currently locked from withdrawals by the administration.

createdAt.description: When the wallet was first initialized.

updatedAt.description: When the wallet was last updated.

MatchResult.title: Pro League Match Result
MatchResult.description: Details of a match result submitted for approval.

TournamentSupportMessage.title: Tournament Support Message
TournamentSupportMessage.description: A single chat message exchanged between players/hosts and administrators regarding a specific tournament.

text.description: The text content of the support message.

senderId.description: The unique user ID of the sender.

senderName.description: The display name of the sender.

senderPhoto.description: Profile photo URL of the sender.

senderRole.description: The role of the message sender.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

LoneWolfMatch.title: Lone Wolf 1v1 Match
LoneWolfMatch.description: Lone Wolf 1vs1 competitive arena match details and participants.

LoneWolfChatMessage.title: Lone Wolf Chat Message
LoneWolfChatMessage.description: A single chat message exchanged between players, hosts, and admins regarding a specific Lone Wolf match.

text.description: The text content of the message.

senderId.description: The unique user ID of the sender.

senderName.description: The display name of the sender.

senderPhoto.description: Profile photo URL of the sender.

senderRole.description: The role of the message sender.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the message was sent.

UserFollow.title: User Follow Relationship
UserFollow.description: Follow relationship linking a follower user ID to a host user ID.

userId.description: UID of the user who is following.

hostId.description: UID of the host being followed.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when follow relationship was created.

SystemConfig.title: System Configuration & Announcements
SystemConfig.description: System-wide settings such as profile screen headline news, tournament profit percentages, and ads pricing.

enabled.description: Flag determining if the headline is displayed.

badgeLabel.description: Tag badge such as HEADLINE, NOTICE, or URGENT.

whatsappPrefillText.description: Pre-filled starter message when tapping WhatsApp.

updatedBy.description: Email or ID of admin who updated the config.

PlatformExpense.title: Platform Expense Record
PlatformExpense.description: Log of financial expenses incurred by the platform for marketing, server hosting, prizes, salaries, etc.

system_config/{configId}.description: Global system configurations, percentage settings, and profile headline announcements.

lone_wolf_chats/{matchId}/messages/{mess.description: Real-time communication support chat messages for individual Lone Wolf matches.

tournament_support_chats/{tournamentId}/.description: Direct communication support channel between organizers/players and administrators for a tournament.

tournament_sponsor_ads/{adId}.description: Sponsor slots for the tournament/home header.

upazila_sponsor_ads/{adId}.description: Sponsor banner slots displayed in the Upazila League hub.

device_stats/{deviceId}/daily_stats/{sta.description: Tracks daily ad watching statistics at the device level to prevent multi-account exploitation.

users/{userId}.description: User profiles managed via Firebase Auth and Firestore.

tournaments/{tournamentId}.description: Tournament listings, details, and dynamic match scores.

admin_logs/{logId}.description: Activities of administrators, visible by main administrators.

settings/{settingId}.description: Global customizable settings like token purchase costs.

team_invitations/{invitationId}.description: Invitations sent to other players to join a team.

host_wallets/{hostId}.description: Host locked/unlocked token security wallets for pro hosting.

pro_league_schedule_matches/{matchId}.description: Match overrides including room details, status, and scores.

pro_league_match_results/{resultId}.description: Detailed match results for approval workflow.

platform_expenses/{expenseId}.description: Log of platform expenses tracked by admins.
